Saigon - Hanoi Securities Joint Stock Company hereby provides an explanation of the
change in profit after tax for the second quarter of 2026 as follows:
UNIT: VND
Item Q 2/2026 Q 2/2025 Increase/(Decrease)
Profit after tax 75.774.982.473 382.739.364.894 (306.964.382.421 )
Profit after tax for the second quarter of 2026 was VND 75.8 billion, representing a decrease
of VND 306.9 billion, equivalent to an 80.2% decrease compared to the same period in
2025. The decrease was mainly attributable to a decline in the results of proprietary trading
activities compared to the same period of the previous year, primarily due to changes in the
fair value of the Company's FVTPL financial asset portfolio at the end of the period.
The above is the explanation provided by Saigon - Hanoi Securities Joint Stock Company
regarding the change in profit after tax for the second quarter of 2026.
